title: Make turn-end a legal waiting_on kind and stop orient calling it a blocker
action:
REWORK of a NEEDS_REVISION verdict on commit b956e03e. The original cell is done and green; two things remain, and only one of them is yours.

NOT YOURS — the judge's K1 failure (orient.rs held a hand-written "turn-end" literal instead of sharing record.rs's constant) was already repaired by cell awm-2 in commit 8461cccc, which introduced pub(crate) const WAITING_ON_KIND_TURN_END in record.rs and made both orient.rs and the Stop hook read it. Do not touch record.rs or orient.rs. Read the constant only to reference its name.

YOURS — a test-coverage gap the judge recorded under check T1. The refusal-message assertions still pin only the OLD two-value substring:
  packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/workflow_store/tests.rs:371   assert!(m.contains("kind must be one of gate/question"), "{m}")
  packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/workflow_store/tests.rs:484   assert!(m.contains("kind must be one of gate/question"), "{m}")
(search for the assertion text; the line numbers are anchors and may have drifted). Because the refusal message is rendered from WAITING_ON_KIND_VALUES.join("/"), a regression that dropped turn-end from the array would still satisfy contains("gate/question") and both tests would stay green — the judge's exact words: nothing pins the third value in the message.

Tighten both assertions so the third value is pinned too. Assert the FULL rendered list, not a prefix substring — the point is that removing any legal value from the vocabulary must turn these red. Reference WAITING_ON_KIND_TURN_END (or WAITING_ON_KIND_VALUES itself) rather than writing the string a second time, so the assertion cannot drift from the constant it is guarding.

Do NOT touch packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group/tests.rs — it carries the same stale assertion at :586 but is RESERVED BY ANOTHER WORKTREE (feature start-feature-reservation-scope, cell sfrs-1). Note in your trace that it is still owed, so it can be re-triaged after that worktree merges.

Prove the tightening actually bites: temporarily remove turn-end from WAITING_ON_KIND_VALUES in your working tree, confirm both assertions go RED, then restore record.rs to HEAD exactly and confirm green. Report that red-then-green in your Result form — it is the only evidence that the new assertion is not another tautology.
